444:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Warriors of $$ハイアデス$$...!」

444:t_000:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Lady $$エルーナ$$ has given the order! We'll crush $c with everything we've got!」

444:t_000:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We've been cleared to use $$アルデバル$$ too! There's nothing left to stand in our way!」

444:t_000:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We will make this moon the grave of $$ランド・トラビス$$... I mean, of $c!!」

444:t_000:8.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(HA! So the Captain's grudge against $$ザ・ヒート$$ has gotten this far!)

444:t_000:9.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(No wonder. His opponent is Lady $$エルーナ$$'s favorite, after all.)

444:t_000:10.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(What a hassle. I wish he'd just charge Lady $$エルーナ$$ and crash and burn.)

444:t_000:11.en:
$$ハイアデス$$
(Well, if he does, we'll be stuck keeping him company all night with a full course of whining and booze.)

444:t_000:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You there! Are you listening!?」

444:t_000:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Here they come! Steel yourselves! We are the strongest, invincible $$ハイアデス$$!」

444:t_001:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards! Their target is $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$!?」

444:t_001:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But they've seized the $$白の宮殿$$ where $$ディアナ$$ is, too...!」

444:t_001:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「It was $$ディアナ$$ who told us to go to $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$. We give that everything we've got right now!」

444:t_002:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$ランド・トラビス$$! And you too, $c!」

444:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「It's like $c is just a bonus tacked on to $$ランド$$.」

444:t_002:2.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That $$ダバラーン$$ guy really seems to hate $$ランド$$, doesn't he?」

444:t_002:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Being popular is rough, huh, $$ランド$$.」

444:t_002:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a pain, in more ways than one.」

444:t_002:5.en:
$$メール$$
「This is all because Darling was checking out that Holstein with lewd eyes!」

444:t_002:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I was not! She's the enemy, damn it.」

444:t_003:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「What's going on!? Didn't $$ランド・トラビス$$ sortie!?」

444:t_003:1.en:
$$シン$$
「That guy... he can't see anything but $$ランド$$, can he?」

444:t_003:2.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That $$ダバラーン$$ guy really seems to hate $$ランド$$, doesn't he?」

444:t_003:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Being popular is rough, huh, $$ランド$$.」

444:t_003:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a pain, in more ways than one.」

444:t_003:5.en:
$$メール$$
「This is all because Darling was checking out that Holstein with lewd eyes!」

444:t_003:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I was not! She's the enemy, damn it.」

444:t_004:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$n... How's $$ジェニオン$$ doing?」

444:t_004:1.en:
$n
「Not bad. Activating GAI Mode should go more smoothly than before, too.」

444:t_004:2.en:
$n
「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$... I'll master it, no matter what...!」

444:t_004:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
(A machine guiding a person... Where is $n headed, I wonder...)

444:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, pay no mind to $$エルーナルーナ$$ of the $$ゲンガナム$$! First we put everything into retaking $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$!」

444:t_005:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't worry, $$ティファ$$. I'll definitely take $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ back.」

444:t_005:3.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Be careful. I have... a bad feeling.」

444:t_005:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even so, we can't back down! We have no choice but to do this!」

444:t_005:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Please wait for us, $$ディアナ$$... We will surely save you.)

444:t_006:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Why did the $$サイデリアル$$ go after $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ anyway?」

444:t_006:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Because the truth about the $$黒歴史$$ is hidden here. I bet that's what they wanted to know.」

444:t_006:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「You mean a past someone wants to erase?」

444:t_006:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Now that you mention it, in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ the term $$黒歴史$$ was used in that sense.」

444:t_006:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「Some of the worlds that made up the $$ＵＣＷ$$ were actually in the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s far future, and their past era was called the $$黒歴史$$.」

444:t_006:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$ＵＣＷ$$ was also a multiverse, made up of various parallel worlds gathered together, but...」

444:t_006:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The future if that $$ＵＣＷ$$ walks the worst path of history... That was the world $$ガロード$$, $$ロラン$$, and the others came from.」

444:t_006:10.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Timelines are irrelevant before a $$時空震動$$... And if you look at it as one possibility of a world, the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s future can be called a parallel world too.」

444:t_006:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「The worst future of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ where $$カミーユ$$ and the others were... and the past for $$ガロード$$'s world... So that is the $$黒歴史$$.」

444:t_006:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Conjecture. The past of the $$残されの海$$, as found in the data left in the $$霧の海$$, is...」

444:t_006:16.en:
$$レド$$
「Stop, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. There is no need to say it.」

444:t_007:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$! If you're here, then $$ディアナ$$ is safe too!」

444:t_007:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's been a long time, Your Excellency $$ディアナ・ソレル$$.」

444:t_007:6.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I'm glad to see you well too, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

444:t_007:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What became of $$エルーナルーナ$$, who seized the Moon's capital?」

444:t_007:8.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「She acknowledged her subordinates' defeat and left.」

444:t_007:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Quick to concede, isn't she, that woman.」

444:t_007:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Since when is that woman the type for that...」

444:t_007:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So, $$ディアナ$$... why did you come here?」

444:t_007:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But didn't he fall asleep...」

444:t_007:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Fall asleep... what do you mean?」

444:t_007:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The will of a person who was once called a $$ニュータイプ$$ is sealed inside $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$.」

444:t_007:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The name is the same, but it's a little different... If anything, it's a being with something closer to $$ティファ$$'s ability.」

uncertain: D.O.M.E. rendered with the #keyword token (facility) in every row since all rows treat it as a place (go to / retake / guide to / sealed inside / hidden here); 444:t_007:13 Garrod's あいつ = D.O.M.E. the being, rendered 'he' (glossary: male).
444:t_000:8 ザ・ヒート憎し: read as Dabalan's grudge against Rand ('the Captain's grudge against The Heat'); 隊長 = 'the Captain'.
444:t_000:5 アルデバル rendered with the Aldebar robot token as a bare name.
444:t_002:5 ホルスタイン kept as 'Holstein' (Mel's insult for Elunaluna).
444:t_006:6 Kira: 世界の一部 rendered 'Some of the worlds'; 444:t_006:5 黒歴史 as ADW slang uses the same $$黒歴史$$ token.
444:t_007:5 閣下 = 'Your Excellency'; honorifics on ディアナ様 dropped per style (plain $$ディアナ$$), matching finished slices.
